sources.version: 2026-09-25: definition, seven decisions, call with Stewart, round-3 amendments, round-4 corrections, late name-only rule; carried in HANDOFF.md and workflows/

sources.ref: Scope and Quote v2, 'Oxford Lancers — Granular Roles & Permissions', schusteratops, prepared for OULAFC
sources.version: 25 September 2026, revised the same day after the call with Stewart

decisions.reason: Access is edited on the seat page and nowhere else; the Roles index is unchanged.
Roster categories are the board's ten groups plus Contact & emergency, none / view / edit each.
Recruiting is its own group: Person information, Recruit details (none / view / edit), Event details (none / view).
Events are granted per template at none / view / manage; no event types or categories; a template added later is one more line.
Two switches per seat, may add to the roster and may add recruits; there is no records switch.
President, General Manager and IT Officer hold everything and cannot be reduced; Vice-President and Secretary start full and are removable one grant at a time; every other seat starts with None.
Grants are edited by holders of role_management (President, General Manager, IT Officer).
Every grant change, Copy access and Grant everything is audited in audit_events.
Copy access from another seat and Grant everything, each one audited action on the seat page; approved with W1 as drawn on W1-03, W1-07 and W1-08.
No time-limited delegation in this delivery; W1-09 retired in round 3.
The Roster group lists eleven categories (Recruits moved to Recruiting); approved as drawn on W1-03.
Roster group colours become editable from an Edit categories control at the top right of the roster.
Edit categories is the same contained Button and size as Add players, side by side (round 4).
Thirteen swatches: key blue becomes Oxford Blue #002147, Lancer Gold #C09723 added, every other swatch unchanged; no Lancer Blue (round 4).
Person and Membership Oxford Blue; Onboarding and Kit Lancer Gold; Availability Slate; Coaching Indigo; Offensive Teal; Defensive Purple; Special teams Brown; Warmup Cyan.
Band head text is charcoal on Lancer Gold and Orange, white elsewhere.
Group colours are edited by holders of role_management; approved as drawn on W2-01.
On the board a None group's columns, filters and card chips are absent.
In a record a None section is collapsed and locked, a lock in place of the chevron, cannot be expanded, and its contents are never sent to the browser; the name stays at the top.
Records open for anyone who can reach the roster or recruits; view on the board is view in the record.
Contact & emergency becomes its own record section, split out of Person.
Contactable stays in Person and Missing stays where it is on the board; the Mobile chip keeps dialling under View on Person, approved as drawn on W3-02.
With None on Person a roster row shows the name only; the Contactable and Missing indicators are absent (late locked decision, 2026-09-25).
Record header status is plain secondary text, never a pill (round 4).
The record's Attendance section follows the seat's grants like every other section, locked where drawn locked; approved as drawn on W3-03.
Notes, What changed and Status history on a prospect record read as Recruit details; approved as drawn on W3-04b.
Coaches become ordinary operators driven by their grants and leave the attendance-only shell; a seat with no roster or recruiting grant does not see Roster or Recruitment.
None on a template hides its events from the events list, the calendar, the event pages and Follow-ups.
Under View every control that creates, edits, deletes, sends or schedules is absent, not disabled.
Manage includes approving and releasing invitations.
Create event appears with Manage on at least one template and offers only those templates.
The events Type filter lists only granted templates.
Templates keep their own colour and the event templates page is unchanged by this delivery.
Attendance is not in the access list; recording stays as it is for every seat.
The delivery board is the Follow-ups queue, narrowed to granted templates; approved as drawn on W4-04.
Event info link stays under View because it copies a public link and sends nothing; approved as drawn on W4-05.
A template manager cannot edit the template itself; Edit templates is absent, approved as drawn on W4-01.
How the attendance recording surface lists events once grants exist is not drawn; the only fixed rule is that recording stays as it is for every seat.
decisions.evidence: Round-1 decision 5 and the round-3 brief item 7 fix only that attendance is outside the access list; no screen draws the attendance surface.

decisions.reason: Scoping of the per-event Delivery page follows the template grant of its event; the mechanism is not drawn.
decisions.evidence: HANDOFF.md open question W4-04 distinguishes the per-event Delivery page from the Follow-ups queue; only Follow-ups is drawn.

decisions.reason: Reverting the interim elevation of named seats (LAN-406) when grants ship, and its ordering against the grant seed, is the Lead's.
decisions.evidence: Scope and Quote v2: the interim elevation stays in place until this ships; W1 specification, Dependencies: LAN-406 untouched by the design.

decisions.reason: A printed-access test that pins the seed to the seed rule is required; its form is the Lead's.
decisions.evidence: W1 specification, Acceptance evidence: 'A printed-access test pins the seed to the seed rule (delegated).'

decisions.reason: Table shapes, capability derivation, audit row shape and the package split are the Lead's.
decisions.evidence: W1 specification, Core decisions: 'Table shapes, capability derivation, audit row shape, printed-access test, package split — delegated to Mission Lead'.

decisions.reason: Who may pause messaging (LAN-407) stays in code.
Erasure is unchanged.
The Roles page's seat-replacement rules are unchanged.
The generalised messaging module is separate work with its own scope and price.
The Monday report is not scoped to granted templates by this delivery, and who may open it is unchanged.
The attendance-sheet email is unchanged.
Per-group scoping for coaches: a coach with edit on a category edits it for the whole squad.
Each seat's page under Roles becomes the access editor for the three administering seats, with a full audit trail.
Grants for role x roster category and role x event template are club data; on delivery the core four and IT Officer hold everything and every other seat holds nothing.
A new template starts with the full seats only; W1's approved specification gives it Manage for the five full seats (see the packet's nonblocking unknowns).
The colour of each roster group becomes editable from the roster page.
View and edit per category on the board and the record, with locked sections and the two add switches.
Coaches become ordinary operators driven by their grants; the attendance-only view is retired.
Acceptance case: the Kit Manager opens a player and records kit; contact, emergency and availability are locked and never reach the screen; entries audited under the Kit Manager's seat.
Acceptance case: once granted, coaches view the football categories and edit availability, coaching, offensive, defensive, special teams and warm-up for any player; attendance unchanged.

Template visibility applies everywhere events appear; create, edit, delete, send and schedule are gated by Manage. The attendance list and the report are governed by LAN-424's D-attendance-surface and D-monday-report.
Acceptance case: the Social Secretary manages the Social template, sees every social event with its RSVPs and answers, creates, edits, sends and runs delivery, and sees no other event.
Delivered as one release to the production app with the club's existing data and seats intact; release order and migration sequencing are the Lead's.
decisions.evidence: Scope and Quote v2, Deliverables: 'Delivered as one release to the production app, with the club's existing data and seats intact.'

decisions.reason: The quote's palette (Lancer Blue added, the current blue kept as Oxford Blue) is replaced by Brian's round-4 palette: key blue becomes Oxford Blue, Lancer Gold added, no Lancer Blue.

approval.words: Other than that, I think this is approved. We can go ahead and create the packet and push it.

decisions.reason: The quote's four exclusions: per-group scoping for coaches, who may pause messaging, erasure and seat-replacement rules, the generalised messaging module.
decisions.evidence: Scope and Quote v2, Out of scope; 00-boundary.md, Out of scope (approved by Brian 2026-09-25)

decisions.reason: /operate/admin/roles and /operate/admin/roles/[roleId] exist, gated by role_management; the seat page's Permissions list is replaced by Access.
audit_events is the existing append-only audit store and is reused for grant and colour changes.
Roster group colours are hard-coded as BAND_COLOURS in src/components/section.tsx and become stored club data.
TEMPLATE_COLOUR_PALETTE and the event_templates_colour_key_known check constraint hold the palette keys that W2 extends.
Every roster and recruitment route is gated by person_record_authority on main and becomes grant-driven.
Coaches see the attendance-only shell on main; granted coaches leave it.
Event actions are gated by event_calendar_management, event_approval and delivery_administration on main and become per-template Manage.
Which of the thirteen capabilities in src/lib/auth/capabilities.ts become derived from grants and which stay in code is the Lead's.
decisions.evidence: W1 specification, Dependencies: 'the capabilities the access list governs become derived from grants; the rest stay in code' — the derivation is unspecified.

areas.name: Seat page access editor
areas.belongs: Where the club administers each seat's grants.
areas.baseline: /operate/admin/roles/[roleId] on main 0d4b6ce5: holder, Permissions list, Holder history
areas.reason: Access replaces the seat page's Permissions list; Copy access and Grant everything live here.

areas.name: Roles index
areas.belongs: The route into every seat page.
areas.reason: Unchanged by this delivery (W1-01 is an identical pair).

areas.name: Grant floor and delivery-day seed
areas.belongs: Who holds what on delivery and who can never be reduced.
areas.invariant: President, General Manager and IT Officer hold everything and cannot be reduced; Vice-President and Secretary start full and are removable one grant at a time; every other seat starts with None on every category and template.
areas.reason: Binds W1, W3 and W4 alike; the club cannot lock itself out.

areas.name: Audit of grant and colour changes
areas.belongs: Every change to access or colours must be attributable.
areas.invariant: Every grant change, Copy access, Grant everything and group-colour change is written to audit_events with actor and before and after per line.
areas.reason: Shared by W1 and W2.

areas.name: Roster group colours and the shared palette
areas.belongs: Roster colours become club data, on the palette event templates also use.
areas.baseline: BAND_COLOURS in src/components/section.tsx; TEMPLATE_COLOUR_PALETTE in src/lib/services/event-template-input.ts
areas.reason: Edit categories on the roster; thirteen-swatch palette; key blue re-toned for templates too.

areas.name: Roster board narrowing
areas.belongs: The board is where most granted seats work.
areas.reason: None groups absent; View read-only; add switch governs Add players; name-only rows under None on Person.

areas.name: Player record locking
areas.belongs: A granted seat opens records and must not receive locked data.
areas.reason: None sections collapsed and locked, never sent; Contact & emergency split out; header status as text.

areas.name: Recruitment board and prospect record
areas.belongs: Recruiting is its own grant group.
areas.baseline: /operate/recruitment and its prospect record on main 0d4b6ce5
areas.reason: Person information, Recruit details and Event details govern columns and sections; may add recruits governs Add recruit and QR code.

areas.name: Navigation and the coaches' attendance-only shell
areas.belongs: Granted seats must reach what they are granted, and only that.
areas.baseline: Operate sidebar and the attendance-only shell for coaches on main 0d4b6ce5
areas.reason: Roster and Recruitment appear only with a grant; coaches leave the attendance-only shell when granted.

areas.name: Events list, calendar, event pages and Follow-ups
areas.belongs: Event access is granted per template.
areas.reason: None hides; View shows everything with manage controls absent; Manage adds create, edit, delete, send, schedule, approve and release.

areas.name: Attendance recording
areas.belongs: Every seat records attendance today.
areas.invariant: Attendance is not in the access list; recording stays as it is for every seat.
areas.reason: Locked by Brian; how the attendance surface lists events is delegated to the Lead.

areas.name: Event templates page
areas.belongs: Templates are the unit of event grants.
areas.invariant: The event templates page is unchanged; templates keep their own colour.
areas.reason: Locked in round 3; the palette re-tone of key blue is W2's consequence, not a page change.

areas.name: Locked data never leaves the server
areas.belongs: The privacy posture of every narrowed surface.
areas.invariant: A None category's contents are never sent to the browser; controls a seat may not use are absent, not disabled; the service layer enforces every grant.
areas.reason: Binds W3 and W4.

areas.name: Who may pause messaging
areas.belongs: Adjacent authority question raised as LAN-407.
areas.reason: Stays in code.
